status: draft: expected results need Aanya's approval

cases.prompt: Create an eRFX project with one RFQ stage, 3 line items, invite 1 vendor and publish it.
cases.must: One RFQ stage with 3 line items, 1 vendor invited, published.

cases.prompt: Create an eRFX project with a technical stage and an RFQ stage, fill the questionnaire, assign an evaluator, 2 line items, and publish.
cases.note: two-stage schedule (both stages must end together)
cases.must: Technical + RFQ stages, questionnaire and evaluator set, 2 line items, published; both stages end together.

cases.prompt: Create an eRFX project with a technical stage and an auction stage and publish it.
cases.must: Technical + auction stages, published.

cases.prompt: Create an eRFX project with an auction stage and 5 line items and publish it.
cases.must: One auction stage with 5 line items, published.

cases.prompt: Create an eRFX project with 25 line items and publish it.
cases.must: 25 line items, published.

cases.prompt: Create an eRFX project with 70 line items and publish it.
cases.note: the company's line-item ceiling (65 for non-BOQ): publish should be refused, not pass
cases.must: Procol refuses to publish 70 line items (the company's limit is 65); nothing is published.

cases.prompt: Create an RFQ, add 3 line items, then remove 2 of them and publish.
cases.must: 3 items added, 2 removed: published with exactly 1 line item.

cases.prompt: Create an RFQ with 2 line items and save it as a draft, then find it under Drafts.
cases.must: Saved as a draft with 2 line items (not published) and found under Drafts.

cases.prompt: Create a single-stage RFQ with line-item awarding and publish it.
cases.must: Single-stage RFQ with line-item awarding, published.

cases.prompt: Create a single-stage rank-based auction with lot awarding, 2 items, and publish it.
cases.must: Single-stage rank-based auction, lot awarding, 2 items, published.

cases.prompt: Create a single-stage price-based auction with line-item awarding and publish it.
cases.must: Single-stage price-based auction with line-item awarding, published.

cases.prompt: Create a single-stage traffic-light auction with a green range of 80 to 120 and publish it.
cases.must: Single-stage traffic-light auction, green range 80 to 120, published.

cases.prompt: Create a single-stage RFP, fill the questionnaire, assign an evaluator and publish it.
cases.note: the single-stage RFP screen (own evaluator select)
cases.must: Single-stage RFP with questionnaire and evaluator, published.

cases.prompt: Create a single-stage RFQ and save it as a draft.
cases.note: must be refused honestly: that screen has no Save as draft
cases.must: spine.ai says it cannot save this screen as a draft (the screen has no Save as draft).

cases.prompt: Create a BOQ project, choose a BOQ template, add 2 line items and publish.
cases.note: BOQ items arrive by upload only: expect "cannot be expressed", never a fake pass
cases.must: spine.ai says BOQ items can only be uploaded, so it cannot test this; no fake pass.

cases.prompt: Create an RFQ with one line item whose quantity is -5 and try to publish.
cases.note: inline validation on a numeric cell
cases.must: Procol rejects quantity -5 in the sheet; the event is not published.

cases.prompt: Create an RFQ with one line item whose quantity is "ten" and try to publish.
cases.must: Procol rejects the text "ten" in the quantity cell; the event is not published.

cases.prompt: Create an RFQ and publish it without choosing a template.
cases.must: Participants and Publish stay locked without a template; nothing is published.

cases.prompt: Create an RFQ and publish it without any line items.
cases.note: "Please choose a template and add a product"
cases.must: Procol says "Please choose a template and add a product"; nothing is published.

cases.prompt: Create an RFQ with 2 line items and publish it without inviting any vendor.
cases.must: Publish is blocked with no vendor invited; nothing is published.

cases.prompt: Create an RFQ with a line item and publish it without a title.
cases.must: Procol requires a title; nothing is published.

cases.prompt: Create a technical stage only, add a questionnaire but no evaluator, and publish.
cases.must: Procol says "Please add Evaluator"; nothing is published.

cases.prompt: Create an eRFX project with both an RFQ stage and an auction stage.
cases.note: impossible composition: must be refused/reshaped, never composed
cases.must: spine.ai refuses or reshapes the impossible RFQ + auction combination; it never builds it.

cases.prompt: Create an RFQ with 2 line items, invite 2 vendors, place a surrogate bid for each and open Master QCS.
cases.must: 2 vendors invited, a surrogate bid for each (2 bids from 2 vendors), Master QCS opened.

cases.prompt: Create an RFQ, invite 1 vendor, place a surrogate bid, then place a second surrogate bid for the same vendor.
cases.note: Add Bid is gone after a bid: expect the refusal, not a second bid
cases.must: The second surrogate bid for the same vendor is refused (Add Bid is gone): 1 bid only.

cases.prompt: Create an RFQ, invite 3 vendors and place surrogate bids for all three, then compare them on Master QCS.
cases.must: 3 vendors invited, 3 surrogate bids from 3 vendors, compared on Master QCS.

cases.prompt: Create an RFQ, invite the vendor "QA_Platform Vendor 1" by name and place a surrogate bid for that vendor.
cases.must: "QA_Platform Vendor 1" invited by name and a surrogate bid placed for that vendor.

cases.prompt: Create an RFQ and invite the vendor "Acme Nonexistent Supplier" by name.
cases.note: a name the search cannot find: falls back to invite-all, says so
cases.must: spine.ai says "Acme Nonexistent Supplier" was not found and that it invited others instead; it never claims Acme was invited.

cases.prompt: Create an auction with one item, invite a vendor and place a surrogate bid of 100, then a revised bid of 90 for the same vendor.
cases.must: Auction with one item: bid of 100, then revised to 90 for the same vendor.

cases.prompt: Create an RFQ with one item, invite a vendor, place a surrogate bid, close the event and try to place another surrogate bid.
cases.note: no bid after the window (unless the tenant allows surrogate post-expiry)
cases.must: No new surrogate bid once the event is closed: still 1 bid.

cases.prompt: Create a technical-only event, invite a vendor and place a surrogate bid.
cases.note: surrogate bids are not possible on a technical stage: expect a refusal
cases.must: Surrogate bids are not possible on a technical stage: Procol refuses, no bid.

cases.prompt: Create an RFQ, publish it, convert it to a knockout auction and place a surrogate bid.
cases.must: A knockout auction forbids surrogate bids: Procol refuses, no bid.

cases.prompt: Create an RFQ, invite a vendor, place a surrogate bid and send a counter offer of 90 to that vendor.
cases.note: Counter Offer is disabled on a surrogate bid: expect the honest refusal
cases.must: Counter Offer is disabled on a surrogate bid: the run reports the refusal.

cases.prompt: On an event where a vendor has already bid, send a counter offer of 90 and confirm it was sent.
cases.note: prepared "bid" state, counter offer on the vendor's own bid
cases.must: Counter offer of 90 sent on the vendor's own bid, and shown as sent.

cases.prompt: On an event where a vendor has already bid, send a counter offer and have the vendor accept it from the supplier portal.
cases.must: Counter offer sent and accepted by the vendor in the supplier portal.

cases.prompt: On an event where a vendor has already bid, open the vendor's bid on the Responses tab and verify the bid price and total match what the API holds.
cases.must: The bid price and total on the Responses tab match what Procol's API holds.

cases.prompt: Create an RFQ with 2 items, invite a vendor, place a surrogate bid, then reject that vendor's quote from the Responses tab.
cases.must: The vendor's quote is rejected from the Responses tab.

cases.prompt: Create an RFQ with 3 line items, invite 1 vendor, place a surrogate bid and award that vendor.
cases.note: the full chain with the wait for the window to close
cases.must: 3 line items, 1 vendor bid, the window closed and the vendor awarded.

cases.prompt: On an event with bids in, start awarding, allocate every line to the vendor and check the counters read 3/3 items and 1/1 vendors.
cases.must: Every line allocated to the vendor; the counters read 3/3 items and 1/1 vendors.

cases.prompt: On an event with bids in, start awarding and submit the proposal, then approve the award.
cases.must: Award proposal submitted and approved.

cases.prompt: On an event with an award proposal, open the proposal and submit it with the required remarks left empty.
cases.must: Submitting the proposal with required remarks empty is refused.

cases.prompt: On an awarded event, create a purchase order and check the PO lists the awarded items.
cases.must: A purchase order is created and lists the awarded items.

cases.prompt: On an event with bids in, award the vendor and then try to place another surrogate bid.
cases.must: After the award, no new surrogate bid can be placed.

cases.prompt: On an event with bids in, open Master QCS and verify the L1 vendor is the one with the lowest total.
cases.must: Master QCS marks as L1 the vendor with the lowest total.

cases.prompt: On an event where a vendor has bid, close the event and open Master QCS before any award.
cases.must: The closed event's Master QCS opens before any award and offers Start Awarding.

cases.prompt: Create an RFQ, publish it and extend the submission time by 30 minutes from the Settings menu.
cases.must: Published, then the submission time extended by 30 minutes from Settings.

cases.prompt: Create an RFQ, publish it and withdraw it with a remark.
cases.must: Published, then withdrawn with a remark.

cases.prompt: Create an RFQ scheduled to start in 2 hours, publish it and reschedule it to start 4 hours from now.
cases.must: Scheduled 2 hours ahead, published, then rescheduled to start 4 hours from now.

cases.prompt: Create an RFQ, publish it, create a new version, remove one line item and publish the version.
cases.note: BUG-86 territory (removing items blocks the version's publish)
cases.must: BUG-86: removing a line item blocks the new version's publish. The run must stop there and report it (green only if fixed).

cases.prompt: Create an RFQ, publish it, create a new version and publish it without changing anything.
cases.note: version keeps the stage schedule on one preset
cases.must: A new version published without changes.

cases.prompt: Create a technical + RFQ project, publish it, create a new version and publish it.
cases.note: the copy drops the evaluator and questionnaire (chained recovery)
cases.must: Technical + RFQ project versioned and the version published (evaluator and questionnaire re-added).

cases.prompt: Create an RFQ, publish it and convert it to an auction, then publish the converted auction.
cases.note: conversion opens a new tab; continue there
cases.must: Converted to an auction and the converted auction published (in the new tab).

cases.prompt: Create an RFQ, publish it and convert it to a dutch auction with a price difference of 5.
cases.must: Converted to a dutch auction with a price difference of 5.

cases.prompt: Create an RFQ, set the bidding window to 3 minutes, publish it and wait for it to close, then confirm it shows under History.
cases.note: the smallest preset is 30 min: the app keeps 30; the plan must report that honestly
cases.must: The app keeps the 30-minute minimum; spine.ai says so and does not claim a 3-minute window.

cases.prompt: Create an RFQ, publish it and force-close it now from the Settings menu.
cases.note: "End" needs trade_force_close on the tenant: expect it to be absent on PROCOL DEMO
cases.must: Force close (End) is not available on PROCOL DEMO; spine.ai reports it absent instead of passing.

cases.prompt: Open the events list and search for an event titled "this title does not exist anywhere".
cases.note: empty state, no random row click
cases.must: The search shows the empty state; no row is opened.

cases.prompt: Open the events list, switch to History and open the first closed event's Master QCS.
cases.note: navigation on an existing closed event
cases.must: History tab, first closed event, its Master QCS opened.

cases.prompt: Create an RFQ, publish it, go back to the events list and open the same event by its title.
cases.note: find the plan's own event, not another
cases.must: The run's own event is found again by its title in the list and opened.

cases.prompt: Open the Drafts tab and open a draft that has a technical stage.
cases.must: A draft with a technical stage is reopened from Drafts.

cases.prompt: Open the events list, switch to Recurring and confirm the tab lists recurring events or an empty state.
cases.must: The Recurring tab shows recurring events or an empty state.

cases.prompt: Create an RFQ and verify the vendor receives an email invitation.
cases.note: no mail step exists: must be "cannot be expressed"
cases.must: No email step exists: spine.ai says it cannot test the email invitation.

cases.prompt: Create an RFQ and verify the event is visible to a buyer in another company.
cases.note: needs a second company: must be refused
cases.must: Needs a buyer in a second company: spine.ai refuses.

cases.prompt: Create an RFQ, publish it and check the vendor sees the bid count.
cases.note: vendor-portal visibility: refused or partial, never silently passed
cases.must: Vendor-side bid count: spine.ai refuses or tests only part and names the gap; never a silent pass.

cases.prompt: Create an RFQ and check that the audit log records the publish.
cases.note: no audit-log step: must be refused
cases.must: No audit-log step: spine.ai refuses.

cases.prompt: Create an auction where the price cap is 50 and place a surrogate bid of 60.
cases.note: price cap step missing on eRFX: expect partial with the gap named
cases.must: No price-cap step on eRFX: spine.ai tests only part and names the missing price cap.

cases.prompt: Create an RFQ with a lot-based award and two lots.
cases.note: lots have no browser step: expect "cannot be expressed"
cases.must: Lots have no browser step: spine.ai says it cannot test this.
